gcasGuide.h2: How to Apply via GCAS Portal & Direct Self-Finance
gcasGuide.subheading: Admissions for BSW and MSW courses can be completed online through the official GCAS Gujarat Government Portal or directly at our college campus under Self-Finance quota.
gcasGuide.step1Title: Online GCAS Portal or Direct Registration
gcasGuide.step1Desc: Register online via gcasstudent.gujgov.edu.in or visit our campus admission desk directly for instant form submission.
gcasGuide.step2Desc: Under university preference, select Shri Govind Guru University (SGGU) and choose VJKM Self-Finance College for BSW or MSW programs.
gcasGuide.step3Desc: Visit our dedicated campus helpdesk (Room 102) with original marksheets, caste certificate, and LC for instant verification and seat confirmation.
gcasGuide.helpTitle: Need help with GCAS or Self-Finance admission?
gcasGuide.helpDesc: Our campus admission counselors assist students free of charge with document scanning, online form submission, and direct seat enrollment.

testimonials.h2: Empowering Careers Across CSR, Healthcare & Public Sector
testimonials.subheading: Hear from VJKM graduates who are leading transformative social initiatives across Gujarat and India.
testimonials.t1Quote: The intensive field practicals at VJKM College laid the exact foundation I needed for corporate CSR. The faculty guided us through real field challenges, from rural PRA surveys to corporate project management.
testimonials.t2Quote: Starting with BSW at VJKM gave me deep clarity on social legislations and community psychology. The on-campus GCAS helpdesk and career counseling ensured a seamless transition into professional practice.
testimonials.t3Quote: VJKM Trust's 67-year educational legacy is evident in their rich NGO network. My 30-day block internship in a healthcare NGO landed me my first role as a Medical Social Worker right after graduation.

hero.p: Founded with a vision to make quality education accessible to all, Vadodara Jilla Kelavani Mandal (VJKM) has grown into a trusted educational organization serving students across diverse disciplines. Through its institutions, VJKM promotes academic excellence, ethical values, innovation, and holistic development, preparing students to excel in their careers and contribute meaningfully to society.

history.p: Since its establishment, Vadodara Jilla Kelavani Mandal has been dedicated to expanding educational opportunities throughout the region. Over the years, the organization has established and supported several institutions, continuously adapting to changing educational needs while preserving its commitment to quality, integrity, and community service.

vision.p: To emerge as a globally respected, value-driven Centre of Excellence that nurtures enlightened individuals through excellence in education, research, innovation, and community engagement. Rooted in the rich legacy of over seventy years of dedicated public service, the VJKM Campus aspires to empower learners with knowledge, ethical values, creativity, and leadership, contributing to sustainable development and the advancement of society at the regional, national, and global levels.

mission.h2: The VJKM Trust shall strive to:
mission.li1: Provide high-quality, inclusive, and multidisciplinary education that promotes academic excellence, critical thinking, creativity, and lifelong learning.
mission.li2: Foster a culture of research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and interdisciplinary collaboration to address contemporary societal and industrial challenges.
mission.li3: Uphold the highest standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and good govemance in all academic and administrative endeavours.
mission.li4: Integrate professional competence with human values, social responsibility, environmental consciousness, and constitutional ideals to develop responsible citizens and compassionate leaders.
mission.li5: Strengthen partnerships with industry, government, academic institutions, and civil society to enhance learning, research, skill development, and employability.
mission.li6: Promote equitable access to quality education through scholarships, outreach programmes, and inclusive policies, particularly for underserved and marginalized sections of society.
mission.li7: Preserve and promote India's cultural heritage while embracing global perspectives, emerging technologies, and international academic collaborations.
mission.li8: Contribute to the socio-economic development of Gujarat and the nation through extension activities, knowledge dissemination, innovation, and community service, in keeping with the Trust's longstanding commitment to public welfare.

overview.item2Desc: From foundational degree colleges to specialized Self-Finance institutions offering BSW and MSW programs, fostering academic excellence across disciplines.

timeline.subheading: Over six decades of unwavering dedication to educational excellence, student empowerment, and public welfare.
timeline.m1Desc: Established by visionary social leaders in Dabhoi to extend accessible, quality higher education across rural and semi-urban Vadodara district.
timeline.m2Desc: Expansion of campus infrastructure, introducing undergraduate science, arts, and commerce academic tracks under the Trust's governance.
timeline.m3Desc: Launch of VJKM Self-Finance College offering professional BSW (Bachelor of Social Work) and MSW (Master of Social Work) degree programs.
timeline.m4Desc: Affiliation with Shri Govind Guru University (SGGU), Godhra, and complete integration with Gujarat Common Admission Services (GCAS).
timeline.m5Desc: Modern smart classrooms, statistical IT labs, digital library archives, and 50+ NGO/CSR fieldwork partner network.
